data.name: Killie
data.gender_notes: Killie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Scottish word 'cille', which means 'church'. In Scottish history, a 'killie' was a small rural church or chapel. The name could also have been given to a child born near a church or baptized there. The name Killie carries the meaning “Little church” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Killie usually hope their child will grow to embody little church and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_greek.name: Κίλλη
